title: Favorite clarinet players and George Lewis
summary: Asked about his favorite clarinetist, Vincent names Redline and Donna Handler, and the two men sort out which George was meant, settling on George Lewis.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Who were the great clarinetists? Favorites and rivals

blocks.x: Maybe Punch can answer. Ask him who was his favorite clarinet player, Baier.

He said, who was your favorite clarinet player, Baier? Who was the favorite? Your famous clarinet player, Baier. Baier? Yeah. Uh, I think it was Redline. Who was that? Donna Handler. If you can leave now, Donna Handler.
Ask him who had the black devils and black ones.
Which George? Which George was pretty kind of.
Is George William? What is his last name? Is it George William? Is that George?
Ask him George Lewis or George your boy?

Is George Lewis or George your boy? No, not George your boy. I thought the boy was the first one that came from the war. He was the first one that came back there. Ask him George. That's George William, ain't he? Anybody got this band here, ain't he? He means George that played with Red Allen, huh? He said, it's George that played with Red Allen. What did I say? Is he named William, is he last name? Lewis.
Huh? George Lewis. Oh, George Lewis, yeah.
I thought it was, yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. I thought that's who he was talking about.
I got him mixed up with George William from Kerber.
He had a problem. Yeah. Yeah. Not me and the one in Baton Rouge. Oh, the Trouba- Oakland. Yeah.
